formance budget and acceptance checklist.
# Doran Design
A DSH skill pack for web and product UI design. It registers one agent skill and one short system-pr
ompt section that makes the three-layer design rules apply to every web task.
## What it adds

- Skill `doran-design`: a full playbook covering
- shadcn/ui as the structure layer
- Canvas UI as t

he effect layer
- ThreeUI / three.js as the 3D layer
- the 80 / 15 / 5 visual-area split
- component

selection, performance budgets, fallbacks and an acceptance checklist
- System-prompt section `dora
n-design-rules`: a compact hard-rule set that always applies, including the one-GPU-effect-per-viewp
ort rule, Radix UI Colors, 0.5px borders, the 12px minimum text size and the mobile/reduced-motion f
allback requirement.
The plugin does not write `AGENTS.md`. The hard rules are contributed through `ctx.systemPrompt.sect
ion`, so installing the plugin is enough.
## Install
Install the prebuilt tarball from GitHub Releases:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then add the package to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` list if your DSH version does not reconc
ile bundles automatically:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart the profile after installing.
## Use
Ask the agent for a landing page, dashboard, portfolio or any Canvas/WebGL/Three.js interface. The s
kill is model-invocable under the name `doran-design`; you can also invoke it explicitly with `/skil
l doran-design` where the client supports skill invocation.
## Notes
- The plugin registers the same skill name as the local `doran-design` skill. Runtime skills rank 25
0, so the installed plugin takes precedence when both exist; keep only one to avoid duplicate catalo

gs.
- Runtime skills are registered at rank 250. If another provider exposes the same name, the near

est layer wins.
- The package ships no browser UI; `dsh.client` is intentionally absent.
- Requires
DSH 0.1.0-rc.1 or newer.
